column1: SE Daily Task Assignment — Layered Formula (feeds 8.10-8.12)

Each layer below is its own sub-formula on its own variable. The Final Master Formula at the bottom injects all four layers in sequence to produce the SE's NOMINAL daily task list (≤5 tasks/day, visit-duration-only math, no travel time). This is a ceiling, not a guarantee — the downstream Routing Agent re-checks this list against REAL travel time between the specific stops and may trim it further if that travel would exceed the 180-min ceiling (Routing Agent R1.2/R1.4, GR-R5). A day landing on 3 or 4 tasks because stops were far apart is expected behavior, not a bug in either layer.

column3:
FM_Meetings_Held_MTD = COUNT(Farmer_Meetings WHERE SE=SE AND Period=Current_Month)
FM_Gap = 2 − FM_Meetings_Held_MTD
FM_Days_Left = Days_Remaining_In_Month
FM_Urgency = (FM_Gap > 0) AND (FM_Days_Left ÷ MAX(FM_Gap,1) ≤ Pacing_Buffer_Days)
column4: Tracks whether the SE is falling behind the ≥2 mega-meetings/month target (5.3) and needs one scheduled soon rather than left to month-end

column3:
FM_Scheduled_Today = (FM_Urgency = TRUE) OR (Manually_Scheduled_Today = TRUE)

Day_Type = IF FM_Scheduled_Today = TRUE THEN "Farmer Meeting" ELSE "DC Visit"

IF Day_Type = "Farmer Meeting":
    Daily_Task_List = [Farmer_Meeting_Task]  ← no DC Visit this day
    STOP — skip Layers 2-4 entirely
IF Day_Type = "DC Visit":
    proceed to Layer 2  ← no Farmer Meeting this day
column4: Implements 8.11: DC Visit and Farmer Meeting (the two real Visit Types) are mutually exclusive both ways — Day_Type is decided once, before either branch runs

column3:
Candidate_DCs = Qualify_Visits ∪ Qualify_Outstanding ∪ Qualify_PL ∪ Qualify_LongTerm  (per 8.5)

FOR each DC in Candidate_DCs:
    Matched_Purposes(DC) = subset of {Promise_To_Bill, Promise_To_Pay_Collection,
        Query_Resolution, Sale, Stock_at_DC}  (real Visit Purposes under DC Visit)
    IF DC ∈ Qualify_Outstanding → add Promise_To_Pay_Collection (+ Promise_To_Bill if billing-specific)
    IF DC ∈ Qualify_PL → add Sale
    Query_Resolution / Stock_at_DC may be added ad hoc by the SE regardless of algorithm pre-load
    Task_Weight(DC) = 1  ← one DC Visit = one task slot, regardless of purpose count
column4: Implements 8.12: a DC qualifying on multiple objective lists is bundled into a single DC Visit carrying multiple real system Purposes, per the "Visit Type & Purpose Mapping" bridge sheet

column3:
Priority_Score(DC) = 0.40×Score_Rank1(DC) + 0.35×Score_Rank2(DC) + 0.25×Score_Rank3(DC)
  [DC's top-3 graded objectives per 7.1, with 7.4 override rules applied]

Ranked_Pool = SORT(Candidate_DCs, BY Priority_Score DESC,
               TIE_BREAK = 7.3 order: Outstanding → PL → Visits → Long-Term)
column4: Determines the order candidates are considered in when filling the day's task slots

column3:
Daily_Task_List = []
Time_Used = 0

FOR DC in Ranked_Pool:
    IF COUNT(Daily_Task_List) ≥ 5: BREAK
    Est_Duration = Visit_Duration(45–60 min, per 8.3)
    IF Time_Used + Est_Duration > Field_Minutes_Available(420 min, per 8.2): BREAK
    APPEND (DC, Matched_Objectives(DC)) TO Daily_Task_List
    Time_Used += Est_Duration

RETURN Daily_Task_List
column4: Injects Layers 0-3: applies the farmer-meeting gate first, then fills up to 5 task slots from the ranked, bundled candidate pool within the SE's time budget
